newsitem.title: USA: Signature Resorts files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Signature Resorts files for offering.

text.p: Signature Resorts Inc on Friday said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for proposed public offerings of 3,000,000 shares of common stock and of $100,000,000 aggregate principal amount of convertible subordinated notes due 2007.
Of the 3,000,000 shares of common stock proposed to be offered, 1,600,000 shares will be offered by the company and 1,400,000 shares by certain selling shareholders.
None of Signature's three founders or other executive officers will sell shares in the proposed offering of common stock, it said.

The Convertible Subordinated Notes proposed to be offered by Signature will be convertible into shares of Common Stock of Signature Resorts at a conversion price to be agreed upon by Signature and the underwriters.
